# Lichess chess-openings

These are the unmodified ECO volumes and CC0 notice from the
[2026.04.16 release](https://github.com/lichess-org/chess-openings/releases/tag/2026.04.16)
of Lichess chess-openings. The files were verified against the Git blobs at
[commit a470acc9d1cdcb26018affa90459a6ec8689af79](https://github.com/lichess-org/chess-openings/tree/a470acc9d1cdcb26018affa90459a6ec8689af79).
`sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` checks the pinned local copies from this directory.

The app bundles the original English names and builds its lookup offline.
